sources.snippet: Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo is the most balanced and cost-effective open-source image generation model currently available in the Qwen-Image series. Qwen-Image-2.1 offers four key strengths: Compact Model, Strong Performance, Exceptional Value. Native Transparency, Unified Generation and Editing. Versatile Editing: Multiple References, Local Control, Fidelity, and Comprehensive Capabilities ...
